text:
jane_auditor: Hi team — auditor here. For SOC2 fieldwork next week we need a few items: 1) mapping of alert coverage (which rules detect RBAC misconfig, KMS anomalies, artifact integrity issues) 2) sample alerts + incident playbacks showing alert->incident linkage 3) retention windows and exact artifact storage locations (S3 paths + KMS key IDs) 4) service ownership matrix for signoffs. Can you assemble by EOD Friday? Thanks

sarah: Thanks, jane. We can do that. Quick q — do you want raw alert records or consolidated PagerDuty incidents with links? :eyes:

jane_auditor: Consolidated incidents preferred, but include one raw alert sample for each control so we can verify linkage (alert -> incident -> artifact).

mike: I'll pull incidents and include the runbook playback steps (timeline + commands used). Where should we upload the snapshots? We have a dedicated bucket for audit exports: s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2026/fieldwork-1768884444/

sarah: Note the primary KMS key for exports is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234. Artifacts are envelope-encrypted; manifest includes keyId metadata.

devops-bot: Export job scheduled. Command: 
```bash
./tools/audit_export --start=2026-03-01 --end=2026-03-20 --types=alerts,incidents,artifacts --out=s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2026/fieldwork-1768884444/
```
Job ID: export-1768884444

emily: For RBAC drift I’ll attach a CSV with the rolebinding diffs for the last 90 days. Columns: principal, role, namespace, change_ts, author.

jane_auditor: Good — also need screenshots of console IAM/role history diffs and the exact Splunk/ELK queries used to extract audit logs so we can reproduce.

sarah: Example Splunk saved search we’ll include:
```splunk
index=infra_logs sourcetype=k8s_audit (verb=create OR verb=update) (object_kind=RoleBinding OR object_kind=ClusterRoleBinding)
| table _time user verb object_kind namespace name
| sort -_time
```
We’ll attach the saved search name and export of results.

mike: Caveat — a small subset of artifacts are on-prem in our HSM-protected vault. I’ll include transfer logs, keywrap proof (key ID + rotation timestamp), and the transfer checksum.

jane_auditor: Please annotate the ownership matrix — owner name, owner email, manager, and which control they sign off on.

sarah: Will do. We’ll produce a spreadsheet: service, owner, owner_email, manager, evidence_paths (comma-separated).

jane_auditor: Also flag any exceptions or active vuln triage items that could affect control effectiveness.

mike: There’s one active triage: CVE-2026-0001 (collector). Mitigation applied in staging 2026-03-18, prod patch rolling now. I’ll include mitigation proof (PR links, build IDs, patch timeline).

emily: Upload ETA: Friday 17:00 PST. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Upload completed. export-1768884444 status: SUCCESS. Objects:
- s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2026/fieldwork-1768884444/incidents.json.gz
- s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2026/fieldwork-1768884444/alerts.json.gz
- s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/2026/fieldwork-1768884444/artifacts-manifest.json
Checksum manifest: sha256:abcdef1234567890

jane_auditor: Received — I’ll validate and follow up if anything is missing. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
